fields.name: userId
fields.description: Recipient (filter target). The userId the row was addressed to — the inbox reads with `filter: { userId: <me> }` so each user only sees their own rows.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Classification of what the row is about — `project` | `feature` | `flow` | `environment`. Drives the inbox title/body templates.

fields.name: actorId
fields.description: IAM sub of the user who triggered the action. Duplicates CreatedBy for explicit filter/audit (same precedent as Announcement.authorId).

fields.name: value
fields.description: Resource id (or `${projectId}:${slug}` for env-scoped items). Drives the inbox's resource link.

fields.name: actorName
fields.description: Display name of the actor — what the body renders in place of the IAM sub.

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Project ItemId, used to navigate the row to the right project page.

fields.name: projectName
fields.description: Display name of the project at the time the row was written.

fields.name: featureId
fields.description: Feature ItemId (when the action was on a feature).

fields.name: featureName
fields.description: Display name of the feature at the time the row was written.

fields.name: flowId
fields.description: Flow ItemId (when the action was on a flow).

fields.name: flowName
fields.description: Display name of the flow at the time the row was written.

fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Env slug — canonical (dev/stg/prod/uat) or per-project custom. Renders in env-scoped actions and on flow clones (destination env).

fields.name: oldName
fields.description: Rename source — the project/feature/flow name before the rename. Used by `deriveBody` for env rename sentences.

fields.name: newName
fields.description: Rename target — the project/feature/flow name after the rename.

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp stamped by mark-as-read. Empty string while unread; non-empty marks the row read.
